chunks: But abiding is the glory of your Lord, full of majesty and beneficence.

key_terms.وَجْهُ: Face, denoting the essence or glory of God

ai.seo_question: What does it mean that only the Face of God remains?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted through the lens of *Baqa'* (permanence) versus *Fana'* (perishability), affirming that while all created beings are contingent and transient, the Divine Essence remains eternally self-sufficient. The attributes of *Jalal* (Majesty) and *Ikram* (Generosity/Honor) underscore the dual nature of God's relationship with creation—commanding awe while bestowing grace. This concept is central to understanding the ultimate return to the Divine in eschatological narratives.
